system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you make a melee attack, you can spend 1 Superiority Die when you do, you gain your Follow Up bonus to hit, from the Switch Hitter class feature. On a successful hit you apply Set-Up to the affected creature and then select one member of your Squad, they can spend their reaction to make the same type of attack (Casting a jutsu of the Same Rank or lower if necessary), targeting the same creature.
